note: Priority mosaic of 3 sources (best real value per pixel, not a single dataset) - closes the Piemonte-side nodata gap present in the VDA-only heightmap. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3.

sources.name: DTM0508_002_UNICO (Regione Autonoma Valle d'Aosta)
sources.coverage: Valle d'Aosta side of the park - highest quality. The source ASC is 2.0 m/px (DEM/pngp_extraction_report.txt); extract-heightmap.sh resamples it to this grid, so 'native' here means the target resolution, not the source's.

sources.name: TINITALY 1.1 (INGV)
sources.coverage: Whatever the first two sources miss (mainly the highest peaks) - national 10m mosaic, so it is upsampled wherever this grid is finer than 10 m and adds coverage rather than detail
